一场严重的重力风暴导致了[this.GetName]的地景发生了剧变。这场风暴强劲的重力波动将行星最高的山脉从构造架上剥离，径直提到了星球的上方。

它现在仍然悬浮在上层大气中，由风暴的残余引力作用保持在高空。这一剧变使得地下基岩中以前无法开采的矿物贮藏暴露了出来，也为[owner.GetResearchers]提供了很多可以分析的资料。
texts.en:
A severe Gravity Storm caused an extraordinary transformation of [this.GetName]'s landscape. The storm's powerful gravitational fluctuations severed the planet's largest mountain range from its tectonic shelf, lifting it vertically above the planet.

It remains suspended in the upper atmosphere, held aloft by a residual gravitational effect of the storm. This remarkable upheaval has exposed previously inaccessible ore reserves in the bedrock underneath, as well as providing [owner.GetResearchers] with much to analyze.

引力风暴离开拥有殖民地的星系时（00_on_actions.txt:5436），隐藏事件 cstorms.1740 有1/2概率排程 cstorms.1745（30天后）。

When a gravity storm leaves a system with a colony (00_on_actions.txt:5436) hidden cstorms.1740 has a 1/2 chance of scheduling cstorms.1745 (after 30 days).
